items.title: Ivanti再修補兩個ICS漏洞，CISA已列入KEV警告出現相關攻擊
items.summary: Ivanti於10月29日更新安全公告，為SSL VPN設備Ivanti Connect Secure（ICS）額外修補兩個漏洞，分別為CVE-2026-111357與CVE-2026-118527。

items.title: 91APP遭駭波及臺灣無印良品，官網購物訂單資料恐外洩，日本MUJI App也傳不同資安事件
items.summary: 91APP遭駭事件波及眾多品牌客戶，該公司10月29日召開重大訊息記者會，公布最新調查結果，指出事件可能影響範圍最多達1,329家品牌。臺灣無印良品也於10月30日發表聲明，指出29日接獲第三方雲端服務商91APP通知，其訂單資料庫遭駭。由於MUJI無印良品官網購物的部分訂單資料存放於該資料庫，相關顧客個資可能受到影響。

items.title: 日本公仔業者Good Smile Company遭駭，逾40萬張信用卡部分資料恐外洩，臺灣顧客也可能受影響
items.summary: 日本模型公仔業者Good Smile Company線上商店遭駭，逾40萬張信用卡的部分資訊可能外洩，更嚴重的是，付款頁面還遭到植入惡意程式，受此事件影響期間曾進行付款操作或將商品加入購物車的2,800名顧客，被列為完整信用卡資料可能外洩的對象。值得注意的是，收件地址位於臺灣的顧客雖不在完整信用卡資料可能外洩的對象，但同樣可能有卡號末4碼外洩。

items.title: Alpine Linux遭GitLab重大漏洞攻擊，重建開發基礎設施防範供應鏈風險
items.summary: Alpine Linux專案於10月28日揭露其GitLab伺服器遭遇攻擊，迫使其關閉GitLab服務並重建伺服器。問題源自該專案未及時修補CVSS嚴重性達10.0分的GitLab漏洞CVE-2026-97229，導致攻擊者利用此漏洞發動攻擊。

items.title: Binance遭竊約63億美元加密貨幣，創史上最大竊案，調查指向北韓駭客
items.summary: 加密貨幣交易平臺Binance上周五公告10月29日發生資安事件，電子錢包遭人竊取63億美元等值token，但公司承諾會全額賠償。美國聯邦調查局（FBI）指北韓駭客為背後元兇。 Binance周五初步調查顯示，事件可能和一名DevOps工程師筆電被入侵有關，讓攻擊者得以存取服務容器，並上傳未經授權的提款交易指令。該公司第一時間暫停加密貨幣存、提款，並註銷受影響錢包IP位址的授權、通報執法機關，也和區塊鏈夥伴合作凍結在區塊鏈上的加密貨幣，也尚未發現任何錢包私有金鑰外洩的證據。

items.title: Salesforce收購軍事後勤AI新創Rune，將服務延伸至戰場前線
items.summary: Salesforce上周四（10/29）宣布已簽署最終協議，將收購美國軍事後勤AI新創Rune Technologies，藉此擴充旗下國防業務平臺Missionforce，預計於2027年1月底以前完成交易。

items.title: fix(cli): prevent config writes from empty builder options (#190896)
items.summary: fix(cli): prevent config writes from empty builder options (#190896) fix(config): refuse explicitly empty builder options in config set In builder mode, `openclaw config set` checked its options for truthiness instead of presence. An explicitly empty option (for example an empty `--ref-id` for `gateway.port`) was treated as absent, so the command fell through to another mode and wrote a value the user did not ask for. Empty builder options are now refused by the existing validation, and the config file is left unchanged. Valid sets, refs and provider options are unchanged. Evidence: built CLI in secretless Node 24.22.1 Docker with an isolated config. Main made the unintended write twice; with this change the command refused twice and the config bytes were unchanged. An expanded matrix of 15 cases was corrected, and valid set, ref and provider controls were unchanged. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/190896#issuecomment-6571091387. Thanks @KhanCold. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: fix(browser): mask sensitive field values in snapshots (#188308)
items.summary: fix(browser): mask sensitive field values in snapshots (#188308) * fix(browser): mask credential and payment field values in snapshots Playwright AI snapshots print every input value and render password inputs as plain textboxes, and Chromium's accessibility tree masks password fields but not one-time-code or card fields. Snapshot output is model-facing, so autofilled secrets reached model context. Mask values of password, one-time-code, cc-number and cc-csc fields (and their rendered text descendants) in the Playwright AI, CDP role, and raw ARIA snapshot formats. Fields that cannot be resolved stay masked. Other field values remain readable. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 * fix(browser): redact Chrome MCP sensitive fields * fix(browser): satisfy snapshot assertion safety checks --------- Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5

Split usage work into bounded operation labels so inventory, refresh, and reporting can be distinguished. * test(diagnostics): complete cumulative reader snapshot fixture * fix(diagnostics): preserve wrapper extraction for reader counters Include the counter module in the existing trusted-wrapper source inventory and use an unambiguous snapshot export. Repairs the PR CI import-closure and export-name guards without changing counter behavior.
